prompts: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a 16:9 realistic editorial photograph for an AI literacy course for 16 year olds, cutaway illustrating 'look beyond people who benefit; who might be harmed, excluded, or pressured?' Three high-school-age students in ordinary navy and neutral clothing in a believable school project room are reviewing an AI-generated school club event plan together on a laptop. One student uses a wheelchair and actively points to the plan while the others listen and revise it. Show an event location sketch with stairs and an alternative accessible entrance on a printed paper next to the laptop; the students are thoughtfully identifying an access problem before using the plan. Equal agency and ordinary collaboration, no exaggerated expressions, no stereotypes or inspirational framing. The laptop shows a simple legible header 'AI event plan' and a minimal floor-plan graphic, no other tiny text. Mature candid photographic realism, natural warm daylight, navy/teal warm cream palette. All important objects and faces within the central 85% of the 16:9 frame. No collage, no title banner, no watermark, no logos.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a 16:9 realistic editorial photograph for an AI literacy course for 16 year olds, cutaway illustrating 'test for harm, set boundaries, and give people a way to challenge mistakes'. Two high-school-age students in ordinary navy and neutral clothing working in a believable school project room test an AI-assisted club application tool on a laptop before using it. Over-the-shoulder three-quarter camera makes the laptop screen clear and dominant. On screen a clean simple interface with title 'AI review', a prominent amber status 'Needs human review', and a clear outlined button 'Request a review'. A short paper checklist beside laptop titled 'Test cases' with checkboxes and a hand using a pen to flag a case; screen also shows a small neutral application card with two lines, no real names or personal data. The student's hand points toward the Request a review control while their partner checks the paper. Show active checking and recourse, not passive laptop watching. Mature candid photographic realism, natural warm daylight, navy/teal warm cream palette. Keep key screen content legible at 1280x720 and within central 85% safe area. No collage, no title banner, no watermark, no brand logos.
audit_edit: Edit the supplied 1280x720 video frame. Preserve its retro printed paper style, dark green background edge, slight diagonal perspective, paper texture and restrained colors. Correct only the heading and the two status rows to accurately depict what the company says. Replace 'Audit' with the exact heading 'DraftKings says'. Replace the green checkmark with a neutral green circular bullet and the text with 'Existing monitoring'. Replace the red X with a neutral dark circular bullet and replace its text with 'Predictive system' on one line and 'not adopted' on the next line. No checkmarks, no red X, no assertion of independent audit or testing. Arrange all text with generous spacing on the same paper, fully readable and inside a 7% safe margin. Keep the 16:9 composition, do not add any additional objects, logos, borders or watermark. This is a precise correction to an existing video illustration, not a new course board.
